teeTagging.problem: The 9 colour-tagged tees use key 'tee' (tee=black/blue/white/red/green), NOT 'teebox'. importOverpass reads ONLY teebox=<colour>. So 0/50 tees get a name; all 50 import as 'Tee'.

nineIdentification.method: The club's own colour-coded routing map (Old Canal=blue, Iron Bridge=gold, Escarpment=red) recovered from the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org/web/20070925131605im_/http://www.royalniagara.com/images/coursemap-sm.gif . The 27 legend-coloured markers detected by exact RGB match (Old Canal 25,107,237 / Iron Bridge 204,153,51 / Escarpment 204,51,0), 9 each. Georeferenced onto OSM by fitting an affine transform (scale 0.1795 px/m, rotation ~0 deg, IoU 0.843) between the painted land mass and boundary way 178899710.
nineIdentification.georeferenceValidation: INDEPENDENTLY validated on ponds not used in the fit: all 8 painted water bodies land within 2-53 m of the matching OSM natural=water polygon (w491900971 2m, w490351227 15m, w491901492 19m, w490351225 27m, w1396403427 37m, w1102973944 46m, w1102973941 53m, w1009390017 52m). Marker positions good to roughly +/-50 m.

Old Canal.corridor: NORTH-WEST block, approx 43.1437-43.1483 N, -79.1745 to -79.1810 W - between the clubhouse and the old Welland Canal pond chain (w1102973940-49 / w1009390018-22). Named for the 19th-century canal bordering it.
Old Canal.osmFeatures: NONE. Zero greens, tees, bunkers. Nearest mapped green to any Old Canal marker is 132 m (and that green, w1396403382, is 96 m from an Escarpment marker). All 9 holes absent from OSM.

Escarpment.corridor: EAST corridor, approx 43.1403-43.1478 N, -79.1687 to -79.1730 W - the Taylor Road side running down to the CN Grimsby Subdivision, along the escarpment brow the Bruce Trail (w823863514) follows.
Escarpment.coverage: 7 of 9 holes have a green polygon; 8 tee complexes present. 2 Escarpment holes have no green.

Iron Bridge.corridor: CENTRE / SOUTH-WEST corridor, approx 43.1392-43.1467 N, -79.1740 to -79.1773 W, running down to the CN railway iron bridges over the old canal (w141912730 at 43.1377,-79.1772; w143561273/w145442373 at 43.1371,-79.1799) that name the nine.
Iron Bridge.coverage: 4 of 9 holes have a green polygon (w1396403443, 448, 456, 468) and 4 tee complexes. The 2 northern Iron Bridge holes (markers 43.14662,-79.17339 and 43.14578,-79.17315) plus 3 others have no geometry at all.

ambiguousFeatures: w1396403412-1396403419 (8-deck tee block at 43.1450-43.1459,-79.1709/-79.1716) sits on the Escarpment/Iron Bridge boundary; nearest-marker distances for 416-419 differ by <30 m. reconstructedHoles.caveat: RECONSTRUCTED by pairing each contiguous tee-deck row with the green its deck axis points at. OSM contains no hole numbering whatsoever, so hole numbers are NOT asserted. Distances are tee-centroid to green-centroid in yards, longest deck first.
